name: TH-PVP
summary: A pyrovalerone stimulant related to a-PVP and naphyrone. There is limited information about the drugs effects and safety profile. There is little evidence of human use of this drug.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Pharmacological studies in vitro showed it to inhibit reuptake of the monoamine neurotransmitters, with about 10-fold selectivity for serotonin over norepinephrine and dopamine, whereas the drug did not induce monoamine release. A subsequent study found that it showed similar potency for serotonin and dopamine but was markedly selective for reuptake inhibition of these neurotransmitters over norepinephrine.

uses.text: TH-PVP is a substituted cathinone derivative which has been sold as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the pyrovalerone cathinones such as α-PVP, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, agitation, paranoia and psychosis, and a strong urge to redose.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。其所屬的吡咯戊酮類卡西酮，例如α-PVP，可能造成心跳加速、血壓上升、體溫過高、躁動、妄想與精神病，並讓人產生強烈想追加使用的衝動。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。其所属的吡咯戊酮类卡西酮，例如α-PVP，可能造成心跳加速、血压上升、体温过高、躁动、妄想与精神病，并让人产生强烈想追加使用的冲动。

fact.en: It is a cousin of α-PVP in which the benzene ring has been replaced by a partly saturated naphthalene ring called tetralin. Unlike α-PVP, it leans towards serotonin rather than dopamine.
fact.zh: TH-PVP是α-PVP的近親，把苯環換成了部分飽和的萘環，也就是四氫萘。與α-PVP不同，它偏向作用於血清素而非多巴胺。
fact.zhHans: TH-PVP是α-PVP的近亲，把苯环换成了部分饱和的萘环，也就是四氢萘。与α-PVP不同，它偏向作用于血清素而非多巴胺。
